description: Send gate for outbound messages. Reads message text to evaluate it, and can sign x402 micropayments with a wallet key.

expectedBehaviors.justification: The text of an outbound message, reply or send-tool call is POSTed to https://overwing.ai/api/v1/evaluate (key or free allowance) or /api/x402/evaluate (wallet). Without a key the text is not stored by the service; with a key, storage follows the account's data settings.

Used locally to sign USDC payment authorizations on Base (EIP-712). The key never leaves the process; only signatures are sent. If unset, ClawRouter's wallet file at ~/.openclaw/blockrun/wallet.key is read for the same purpose.

securityNotes: Shadow mode is the default: nothing is altered or cancelled until the operator sets mode to enforce.
A failed, slow or unpaid check never blocks a message: the plugin fails open and logs the reason.
Wallet spending is capped per call and per day; defaults $0.01 and $0.50.
Logs at ~/.openclaw/overwing/logs/ hold verdicts, rules and costs, never the message text.
